blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY— A brass bell, believed to be over a century old, has been recovered after police traced it to a scrap-metal buyer in Bohol who paid P17,000 for it. The bell, reportedly made in 1914, was stolen from Saint Peter the Apostle Parish Church (popularly known as Loboc Church) in Loboc town, and discovered missing by church personnel at 7:50 a.m. on Monday, Oct. 5. Police were alerted about 10 minutes later and immediately reviewed CCTV footage from the area.
